Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-protocol reproduction).

Scene: lawn plane, polygonal pond with rock proxies, reeds, lily pads and a small dock; curved grey path with an upper-left branch; a leaning tree trunk; slatted bench with a blue cloth; two seed sacks; brick walls with hedge boxes, an orange hose tube, an open wooden gate (hinged at the wall end, swung toward the camera), stepping slabs, a brick pillar, a notice board, a red lawn mower, a raised carrot bed and a planter.

Subjects: one gardener (articulated boxes/cylinders: hips, knees, shoulders, elbows, head with cap, radio in left hand) and one goose (ellipsoid body, articulated neck/head with beak, flapping wings, stepping legs).

Action/timing (observed in the 24 samples): goose flaps behind the wading gardener (0-0.45 s), lands on the grass behind him (~0.6 s), walks right/away across the lawn, crosses onto the path (~2.3 s), turns toward the gate (3.4-3.8 s), honks/grabs at the gate edge (~3.7-4.1 s, white burst lines) and walks through the gateway onto the slabs (4.2-4.87 s). The gardener turns from facing camera to facing away (0.4-0.85 s), steps up out of the pond (~1.1-1.6 s) and walks slowly after the goose, leaving frame left near 4 s.

Camera: single continuous shot, no cuts. Fixed 45 deg pitch, 14 deg vertical FOV; target position, small yaw drift (0 to ~8 deg) and distance (zoom out to ~3.4 s, back in by ~4.0 s) were fitted by a small least-squares fit to static landmarks (pond rock, bench, trunk, sacks, gate, slabs, pillar, board) across the samples, then interpolated with cubic Hermite splines.

Inference vs observation: positions at sample times come from the reference images; motion between samples, leg/wing cycles and the gate staying open throughout are inferred. No render feedback has been received yet for this initial version.

Feedback received: round 1 render. Camera framing and object placement matched well; characters and props were ~1.3-1.4x too large, colors rendered much darker than the reference (output behaved as un-encoded), walls/hedges were too tall, the board too wide, and the walking goose's neck too upright.
